description:
Julie Kuhl is a young singer-songwriter from Frankfurt (Germany) who started singing in choirs, learning instruments (guitar, piano, viola) and wrote her first songs as a young kid. In 2022 - by the age of 17 – when Julie's second album “Born With Nostalgic Bones” was released on the Frankfurt label Jazz Montez Records. 
Julie is now collaborating with Cologne musician Gianni Brezzo (Marvin Horsch), who is producing 5 songs with her in the style of Genevieve Stokes, Arlo Parks & Clairo. The Ep CLOUDS OF GRIEF is released on the Jakarta Records sub-label ASMARA RECORDS (Woman & XulZolar). In Japan the EP is released on P-Vine Records.
